description: This PHP class handles importing plugin files within the Revive Adserver project, extending the plugin export class to include import-specific functionality such as preparing, verifying, and copying plugin files, including handling DataObject files and special cases like delivery limitations.

classes.name: OX_UpgradePluginImport
classes.description: A class for importing plugin files, extending the export class to facilitate copying, verifying, and handling plugin files and DataObjects within the Revive Adserver.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a given name, always returns true.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the plugin for import by parsing package and component groups, and identifying DataObject files.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Copies plugin files from the source to the destination, handling special cases like delivery limitations.

methods.name: verifyAll
methods.description: Verifies all plugin files and DataObject files exist in the target location.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies that all files declared in the plugin's XML are present under MAX_PATH.

methods.name: _log
methods.description: Logs messages to the install log file.
